title: Constructing Budgeted KGW Evasion through Token-Event Evidence Replacement
abstract: arXiv:2611.00726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KGW watermarks bias sampling to accumulate keyed detection evidence. We construct budgeted evasion through token-event evidence replacement using ordinary phrase rewrites. Our construction jointly selects compositions of LLM-proposed alternatives from an independent model and measures global token-edit distance on complete outputs. At the largest attainable cost within the budget, exact coverage search maximizes removal of original scored token pairs. It uses a known tokenizer without the key, detector feedback or queries to the watermarked model. Exact accounting separates source evidence removed, evidence created and length effects, with initial strength setting the required reduction. Separate signed-event analysis found that mean suppression arose mainly from removing watermark-enriched source events. translated_title: 通过词元-事件证据替换构建预算受限的KGW水印规避方法
translated_abstract: KGW水印通过对采样进行偏置来累积基于密钥的检测证据。我们利用普通短语改写，通过词元-事件证据替换构建了一种预算受限的规避方法。该构造方法联合地从独立模型提出的LLM替代方案中选择组合，并在完整输出上度量全局词元编辑距离。在预算内可达的最大成本处，精确覆盖搜索最大化了对原始计分词元对的移除。该方法仅使用已知的分词器，无需密钥、检测器反馈或对水印模型的任何查询。精确核算将被移除的源证据、新产生的证据以及长度效应区分开来，并以初始水印强度设定所需的削减量。独立的带符号事件分析发现，平均抑制主要来自对水印富集源事件的移除。在短文本段落上进行受控的、按出现次数计数的、单词元上下文的KGW测试中，82个合格的、初始被检测到的来源中有39个产生了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种预算受限的KGW水印规避方法：仅用独立模型的普通短语改写和精确覆盖搜索，在给定编辑预算内最大化移除水印检测证据，且无需密钥、检测器反馈或查询水印模型，即可显著削弱水印检测。
en_tdlr: A budgeted KGW watermark evasion method that uses ordinary phrase rewrites from an independent model with exact coverage search to maximally remove watermark detection evidence within a token-edit budget, requiring no secret key, detector feedback, or queries to the watermarked model.
